segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: אֶחָד גַּגִּין וְכוּ׳.
segments.en: «Rabbi Shimon says: Roofs,» courtyards, and enclosures are «all» one domain with regard to vessels that were inside them when Shabbat began, and one may therefore carry from one of these areas to the other. However, they are not one domain with regard to vessels that were inside the house when Shabbat began.

moves.summary: quotes the mishna's R' Shimon clause for discussion
moves.about: lemma of R' Shimon's ruling that roofs, courtyards and enclosures are one domain

edges.cueHe: רבי שמעון אומר: אחד גגין וכו׳
edges.about: lemma of R' Shimon's ruling that roofs, courtyards and enclosures are one domain

positions.claim: roofs, courtyards and enclosures are all one domain for vessels that rested in them
